dslRule:
<!id: org.eclipse.jface.text.tests.renameTestReaderMethod>
<!description: Renames a specific JUnit test method 'testTestCaseReader' to 'testTestCaseReader1'. This is a minor refactoring often done to resolve test naming conflicts or adjust to new testing frameworks like JUnit 5, though in this commit, it was related to resolving test logic issues.>
<!severity: INFO>
void $name$($params$) :: methodNameMatches($name$, "testTestCaseReader")
=> void testTestCaseReader1($params$)
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
